name: Orange County, NY
findings: Orange County has 1,213 nonprofit organizations. 447 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 362 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Orange County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Orange County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 207 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 207 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few youth organizations list public events
observations.text: 4 youth organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
